source_title: Trust by Construction: A High-Assurance Reference Architecturefor Agentic AI in Learning Institutions

claims.scope: Strict authority ceiling and interface inventory; host sockets and filesystem still require OS isolation.
Trusted task enrollment, exact purpose and resource binding, expiry and shared workload budget.
Identity, task, Passport, runtime policy, ancestry, model and zone intersection; data rights supplied by trusted enrollment.
Before-disclosure checks and cumulative byte budget in the joined synthetic records adapter.
Persistent authenticated objects, purpose, namespace, logical retention expiry and source reauthorization. Physical backup erasure is separate.
Typed allowlisted transition, canonical resource and expected version; delegates execution to existing transactional joined mediator.
Session taint is monotone; transformations and messages cannot lower classification or remove source references.
Named reviewer approves exact artifact digest and destination, TTL and epoch; explicit declassification; separate recipient authentication.
Persistent identity/parent/task/model/zone/expiry/scope; lifetime population ceiling; aggregate calls/bytes/local adapter work. No network adapters or external billed compute.
Typed internal message channel with audience, labels, source and epoch checks; natural language carries no authority.
Five nested authority modes; contraction and ancestor revocation; named operator restoration invalidates old leases.
Finite capability/message graph with concrete source-to-public counterexample paths. Checked on every model request and prospective message edge; only declared topology is visible.
All six named primitives plus memory reads, effects, and agent messaging; HTTP boundary available; deterministic reference tools only.

limitations: Host/process/credential and OS network isolation require deployment enforcement; Python boundaries are not a malicious-code sandbox.
No arbitrary MCP, browser, shell, cloud API, file-write, streaming, multimodal or external side-effect adapter is enabled.
Compute units are deterministic local adapter input bytes; external cost is zero because no billed adapter is registered. They are not GPU time or live provider billing measurements.
Graph assurance covers the declared service topology; undeclared host paths must be denied by the deployment.
Memory retention is authorization expiry, not forensic erasure of SQLite pages or backups.
SQLite provides local serialized transactions. Distributed revocation, external exactly-once effects, hardware-backed keys and human-review effectiveness are not established.
The new SDK uses the existing joined synthetic record correction adapter; enterprise IAM, institutional policy and orchestrator adapters need deployment-specific binding.
